title.zh: 法国议员支持对持仓超10万欧元加密钱包实施申报规定
title.en: 法国议员支持对持仓超10万欧元加密钱包实施申报规定

current_state.zh: French lawmakers on the National Assembly finance committee backed amendment I-CF821, which would require individuals holding €100,000 or more in self-custodied crypto to declare the value annually, with penalties of up to €10,000 for non-compliance.
current_state.en: French lawmakers on the National Assembly finance committee backed amendment I-CF821, which would require individuals holding €100,000 or more in self-custodied crypto to declare the value annually, with penalties of up to €10,000 for non-compliance.
